mood_modifiers.tense: writhing shadows, geometry beginning to bend, wrongness creeping in at edges
mood_modifiers.joyful: alien beauty, terrible wonder, colors from outside space, transcendent horror

mood_modifiers.epic: cosmic scale revealed, insignificant humans before vast entities, sublime terror
mood_modifiers.peaceful: deceptive calm, the eye of madness, beauty that shouldn't exist, false serenity
mood_modifiers.melancholy: ruins of sanity, aftermath of revelation, broken minds reflected in broken space
mood_modifiers.awe: full revelation of the incomprehensible, sanity-breaking vistas, terrible majesty
mood_modifiers.dread: something approaching, geometry collapsing, the moment before the mind breaks

scene.wide: impossible landscape, non-euclidean architecture, scale that breaks perspective
scene.medium: figure confronting wrongness, human scale against inhuman geometry

scene.low_angle: towering impossible structures, things looming from angles that don't exist
scene.overhead: patterns that suggest consciousness, fractal wrongness, cult circles
